data.name: Module.ChangeNamespace.Description
data.value: Changes source namespaces globally after NCF installation and before release. This operation is irreversible; back up first and do not use it in a running production environment.

data.name: Function.ChangeNamespace.Change.Description
data.value: Change namespaces in all .cs and .cshtml source files

data.name: Function.ChangeNamespace.Restore.Description
data.value: Restore namespaces in all .cs and .cshtml files to the NCF defaults

data.name: Function.ChangeNamespace.Download.Description
data.value: Download the official NCF source for namespace processing

data.name: Parameter.ChangeNamespace.Path
data.value: Path||Local physical path, for example: E:\Senparc\Ncf\

data.name: Parameter.ChangeNamespace.NewNamespace
data.value: New namespace||The namespace root must end with a period and will replace [Senparc.Ncf.]

data.name: Parameter.ChangeNamespace.Source
data.value: Source||GitHub is normally updated first. Gitee is faster in mainland China but may lag; verify the latest GitHub version before downloading.

data.name: Parameter.ChangeNamespace.CurrentNamespace
data.value: Current custom namespace||The root usually ends with a period, such as [My.Namespace.], and will be replaced by [Senparc.Ncf.] or [Senparc.]
